decisions.decision: Determinism is detected, not predicted. No static analysis of task modules.
decisions.rationale: Verification is a byte comparison of the same module run on two nodes. Predicting statically that a module cannot diverge is an unboundedly harder problem, and the comparison is the mechanism regardless. An admission gate was built and deleted: every check was either already enforced by the runtime (imports), impossible with one thread (atomics), or self-reporting as a disagreement.

decisions.decision: The import object is the sandbox — no allow-list code.
decisions.rationale: WebAssembly.instantiate refuses any import the host does not supply, naming it. A hand-written allow-list was reimplementing V8.

decisions.decision: Cross-implementation verification is out of scope.
decisions.rationale: Verification compares the same module on two nodes. Never two independent implementations of the same computation.

decisions.decision: Determinism is enforced at the serialization boundary via strict DAG-CBOR.
decisions.rationale: DAG-CBOR forbids NaN/Infinity/-Infinity, normalizes -0.0, and mandates one float width. Protobuf bytes are never hashed — its own docs state serialization is not canonical across languages, builds, or schema versions.

decisions.decision: Phase 1 (determinism gate) deleted from the roadmap; 11 phases -> 10, 76 -> 72 requirements.
decisions.rationale: The WASM spec makes a generated NaN's sign nondeterministic, so measuring it could never change the design, and DAG-CBOR forbids the value entirely. The gate phase was answering a settled question.

next_action: Start Phase 2 (Real Network, Node <-> Node). Swap a libp2p adapter in behind the existing Transport port; the kernel package must stay byte-for-byte unchanged, which is the actual test that the port boundary was drawn correctly. Covers NET-01 and NET-07.
context_notes: Phase 1 is complete and green: 149 tests across node/browser/worker, tsc --noEmit clean, all four git refs in sync, tree clean, repo private. The dominant lesson of this session was over-engineering: roughly 1200 lines of WASM instruction parsing and a whole roadmap phase were built to statically prove determinism, then deleted once it was clear that comparing two byte strings already did the job. STATE.md carries explicit do-not-reintroduce notes for both the gate and cross-implementation verification. When planning Phase 2, resist the same pull — the transport swap is one adapter class, not a research project.
